audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows were wrong on both layers. The chart handed Levels 2-5 and First item to Kayle while the whys directly beside them read 'you punish', 'favours you', 'you dominate' and 'the lane turns neutral'.
audit.why: Kayle pre-form is melee and dashless with only Radiant Blast's slow; Zaahen has an 850 pull and a dash. The lane inverts at her first item and her level-16 form, not at level 3. The packet levelChart and the already-audited mirror both give Skill / Zaahen / Zaahen / Zaahen / Skill / Skill / Kayle.
audit.corrected: Whole chart proposed as matched full+content pairs: Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen, Zaahen, Skill, Skill, Kayle, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was described only as 'her get-out at 6' with no number, and the page told you to 'trade around Divine Judgment's cooldown' as if it were a short one.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80 at 900 range and can be cast on an ally, not just herself. At rank 1 that is two and a half minutes of lane with no save once it is spent — the largest single window in the matchup.
audit.corrected: The 160s figure now drives breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, spikes[1].text and breakdown.mid, with the bait-then-return sequencing spelled out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither of Kayle's two decisive lane interactions appeared anywhere: Starfire Spellblade is an auto-attack reset that scales with your missing health, and Celestial Blessing heals her through chip on a flat 15s.
audit.why: Riot's text: Starfire Spellblade's active smites her target 'dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health' on 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 at zero cost, and its cast is hidden inside an attack animation — the wind-up is the tell. Celestial Blessing heals herself and the nearest ally on a flat 15s cooldown. Radiant Blast additionally reduces the resistances of everything it hits, so her burst is front-loaded by a shred.
audit.corrected: E reset tell written into spikes[0].text, the Grievous Wounds requirement and the Radiant Blast shred into breakdown.cooldowns, and the invulnerability behaviour into dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Win rate is 47.74% over 842 games — an unfavoured lane — yet diffRating read 4/10, tone was green and the final rating said 'Favoured matchup'.
audit.why: diff is already 'HARD'; the numeric rating and the tone contradicted it.
audit.corrected: diffRating to 7/10, tone to the orange token, breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t rewritten to match.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Divine Judgment and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 7/10. You own the first five levels; the lane is decided by how much you bank before her form spike.

edits.before: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Kayle carry threat 9.5/10.
edits.after: Tricky matchup — difficulty 7/10, Kayle carry threat 9.5/10.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1 — bait it and the next two minutes are free. - Radiant Blast (12s) shreds your resistances before her E reset lands. - Celestial Blessing heals on a flat 15s: buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 160s at rank 1 — bait it early and you own the next two minutes.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Full items plus an 80s invulnerability means you cannot burst her down.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Divine Judgment: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Levels 2-5 are yours: she is melee and dashless, so walk her down every wave. Bait Divine Judgment out before you commit anything lethal.

edits.before: Kayle is a melee, dashless, item-and-level-hungry scaler pre-6 with only Q (Radiant Blast) slow to peel; this is your kill window. Walk her down every wave, land Q (Darkin Glaive) and autos, and try to zone her off XP so her form spikes come as late as possible.
edits.after: Kayle is a melee, dashless, level-hungry scaler pre-6 with only Radiant Blast's slow to peel; this is your kill window. Her damage comes off a Starfire Spellblade (E) auto-reset on 8s that scales with your missing health, so step back on the wind-up. Zone her off XP.

edits.before: Kayle hits ranged form at 6 and gains her R (Divine Judgment) invulnerability, so her own all-in danger is low but she can no longer be dove without eating a save; still, you out-duel her frame here, so keep pressuring and deny farm.
edits.after: Kayle hits ranged form at 6 and Divine Judgment on a 160s rank-1 cooldown, so a dive costs you the dive unless it is spent. Bait it with your E and W, walk away, then come back: two minutes of lane with no save is where the lead is built.

edits.before: Use R (Divine Judgment) invuln to blank your all-in and your jungler's gank
edits.after: Blank your all-in and the gank with Divine Judgment's invulnerability
